items.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.title: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
items.summary: Get more helpful Search responses by securely opting in to connect Google Wallet, Drive, and the Gemini app to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode.

items.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.summary: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
